content: Mona Palenge Singinya Renge Dokona Lakandamana

content.text: Selapa. Mona palenge singinya renge dokome wambu ingyuo kee letamo.
Renge angi dokome wambu serami lao paneya.
Yuu kyau dupwana kata nemba dupwanape
dee kata kandamae dupwanape baa karenge.
Yuu taone andake kambu kondandawame dokona
kame kambu kilikili rename piso kyakale lenge.
Wambu dupwa nambame nakama poraiyuo piso sokondali pilyu.
Nambame isa wambu peparae kando kee leto.
Emba nyaŋa ingyuo karee kande doko suu pingi ando oto kando suu pyao karape.
Emba kopyali ingyuo karee kande doko kando mona palenge ingyuo karape.
Nambana pii ama keyange langilyu dupwa
rolaeŋe sepe.
Namba pii kinyi angi lenge dokome
pii kyambo dupwa epe kanda nange.
Dokona nambame pii letono dupwa peparae kinyiko lenge
dee mendepe kyambo lapala mendena kata palyuo pii nange.
Akali mendeme mona kandapala soo walengena palyuo karenge
dee mendeme mana poraiyuo nyingi ramo doko baa soo oto karenge.
Dokona kana kulingi nyingi doko suu pyao nambana mana pii doko nyelapape.
Dee kana golo rao kui kui lasi rombo palyuo nyingi doko suu pyao nambana mona palenge singinya renge doko rombo palyuo nyelapape.
Namba mona palenge singinya renge doko kamame wakasa ingyapala mamakupi kalya pingi bangepe isa palyingi.
Dokona ingyuo emba range nyelana suu pilini doko namba mona palenge singinya rengepa manda manja nara ingyara.
Namba mona palenge singinya renge dokome soo gisinginya renge doko namba keta palenge.
Dee soo nyinginya renge palengeko dokome namba kote dupwa rolae ingyuo singi.
Nambame wambu range mupwa wakasa lao suu pyapala pii panga soo karo kata koona penge dupwa kando epe kanda nange.
Dokona ingyuo akali mendeme Anatu andakeŋe lao pakao pyuo karara ramo doko baa koo dupwa epe kanda nao kararasa pira.
Nambame dopa pyuo piru lao rapa rapa pyuo pipala angi dokona palyuo pyuo penge.
Dopa pyuo namba soo nyuo porai ingyuo karenge.
Nambame kiŋi dupwa iso karena lao
dee gapomane dupwa lowa waso lena lao nambame nyisingi.
Isa yuu dakena gapomanena akali kamongope kiŋipi karaminyi dupwa
nambame nyisapunu pyuo karaminyi.
Mendeme namba kotara ramo dokome namba kando nyera.
Nambame wambu namba mona retenge dupwa isingi monako retenge.
Namba keta bange aelyamo karenge dokome mainya rae maipala ketae pyambuo maingi.
Dopa pyuo namba kapa palyuo kamongapala maiyuo kumakange.
Namba keta emba bange soo nyilini dupwa kana golo rao kui kui lasi dokopa manda daa.
Dee kana kulingi keyange dokopa kapa daako.
Namba yulu rolaena kata iki pao
kote singi kata angi dokona moko minyuo penge.
Namba mona retenge dupwa bange malu maingi
dee bange dupwame nakamana anda dupwa soo ketae penge.
Kamongome yuu wamba kanda soo dokopa bange dupwa wasalana karo dokopa
namba mona palenge singinya renge doko wambo ingyuo wasiya.
Yuu muu dupwa kanda sepa nao karo
wambo peparae doko namba kanda soo wasiya.
Dee namba ipwa kotape ipwa guu lao epengepe dupwa epapa nayamopa
namba doko wambo manjo nyiya.
Namba yuu kyaupi dee yuu manda dupwa silyamuli pyuo sepa nayamopa
namba doko wambo mandeya.
Anatumi isa yuu dakepa yuu isako pulyuo silyamo dupwape yuu sinjimu wambo siya dokope wasepa nayamopa
namba doko wambo mandeya.
Dee yake doko sera panda reteyamo dokopa namba dokona kareyo.
Dopa pyuo yake yuupa pakali lao koe pyao peyamo dokopa namba dokona opetae kareyoko.
Baame yake dokona kopa sinya lao
ipwa kota pete dokona piso mee ipwa guu lena lao waso
dee ipwa kota dokona siyamo dupwa kando baame lao
raeyo paa napala silyamuli pyuo sinya lao leyamo dokopa namba kareyo.
Dopako pyuo dee yuu kikurenge dupwa waso reteyamo
dokopa namba dokona kareyoko.
Yuu gii dupwa pipya namba akali anda puu rombo minyingi dopale ingyuo baa role kareyo.
Yuu peparae nambame baa rae mainyi pyambuo
dee namba baa role karapala rae maiyuo piyu.
Wambu isa yuunya enenge sipurao paleyaminyi dupwa kando dee yuu muu peparae dupwana kando pipala rae maiyuo kareyo.
Epapu akali parange dupwa nambana pii selapape.
Sepala nambame letonoli pyuo pirami ramo doko nakama rae mairami.
Nakama mana letono doko selapa.
Mona palenge singinya renge doko nyuo kame kame see nalapape.
Akali mende nambana anda kame kambu konandawame dokona isaro petengepe
dee akali mende nambana pii soo nyingipi dupwa rae mairami.
Akali mendeme namba kotara dokome lete karenge renge doko kando nyera.
Nyeramo dokopa Kamongome baa kando rae maira.
Akali mendeme namba kando nyii nara ramo doko baa range randa nyera.
Mendeme namba epe kanda nara ramo doko baa range kumungi renge doko mona reto kararasa pira, leya.
